summary: Fix O large enough for the local defect bound at every place v above ℓ. The crystalline relations are the intersection over v of the local ones, so each block loss is at most the sum over v of local quotients; each is bounded by the length of Z_f of the dual Tate twist of the block modulo the cup-orthogonal of a class containing all lattices u_x and the block (relLength_obeyingCocycles_le), and that by the one-place defect [G_ℓ : j_v]·rank·loss/x (block_defect_le_at_place). Summing over the blocks (rank |r| for the row, x = D.t for the t string blocks) and over v (Σ_v [G_ℓ : j_v] ≤ [E : ℚ] = 2f) gives 4·|r|·D.f·loss.
